# Codex Rate Monitor v0.3.1

## 中文

- **额度面板更灵活**：新增「自动」「全部显示」「仅显示周用量」选项；自动模式适配账号实际提供的额度，预览与托盘摘要同步调整。
- **窗口吸附更稳定**：修复菜单、弹窗导致悬浮条吸附错位的问题；选择右下角吸附时默认多行，仍可手动切换为单行。
- **重置券信息更清晰**：数量与到期文字分别跟随主字号、时间字号；横排卡片与额度面板等宽，完整显示到期信息。
- **修复大尺寸显示问题**：高 DPI 或大缩放下，悬浮条与预览保持一致，避免小屏幕上的窗口宽度被截短。

## English

- **More flexible usage panels**: Choose Auto, Show all, or Weekly usage only. Auto adapts to the quota windows your account provides, with matching previews and tray summaries.
- **More reliable window attachment**: Menus and popups no longer displace the overlay. Bottom-right attachment defaults to multiple rows, with a manual single-row option.
- **Clearer reset-credit information**: Credit counts and expiry text follow the main and time font sizes independently. Horizontal credit cards now match usage-card widths and show the full expiry text.
- **Fixed oversized overlays**: At high DPI or large scales, overlay and preview dimensions stay consistent without the window width being truncated on smaller displays.

[Full changelog / 完整变更](https://github.com/D1NOOO/codex-usage-monitor/compare/v0.3.0...v0.3.1)
